Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning stop work orders on projects that require hydraulic project approval.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to compliance with the hydraulic project approvalrequirements; amending RCW 77.15.300; and adding a new section tochapter 77.55 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If any person or government agency fails to follow the requirementsof obtaining hydraulic project approval under this chapter or fails tocarry out any of the requirements or conditions of a hydraulic projectapproval issued under this chapter, the department may issue a ceaseand desist order to that person or government agency. The cease anddesist order must set forth the specific nature, extent, and time ofviolation, the damage or potential damage, a notice that the violationcease and desist, and, in appropriate cases, the specific correctiveaction to be taken within a specified time. Within twenty days ofservice of a cease and desist or other order or as provided by rule ofthe department extending the time, the person may file a writtenpetition with the department appealing the order, and this petitionmust be treated as an application for an adjudicative proceeding under p. 1 SB 6368chapter 34.05 RCW. In the event of an appeal, a person or governmentagency may seek interim relief from a cease and desist or other orderunder this section as provided in chapter 34.05 RCW.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.15.300 and 2000 c 107 s 239 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as otherwise provided in this section, a person isguilty of unlawfully undertaking hydraulic project activities if theperson constructs any form of hydraulic project or performs other workon a hydraulic project and: (a) Fails to have a hydraulic project approval required underchapter 77.55 RCW for such construction or work; ((or)) (b) Violates any requirements or conditions of the hydraulicproject approval for such construction or work; or (c) Violates any cease and desist or other order issued undersection 1 of this act if that order has been either served on theperson or posted at the site of the violation, except if the personacts in accordance with any relief under chapter 34.05 RCW pursuant toa timely appeal or timely relief from the department cease and desistor other order. (2) Unlawfully undertaking hydraulic project activities is a grossmisdemeanor. (3) A person is not guilty of unlawfully undertaking hydraulicproject activities if the person is subject to a cease and desist orother order issued under section 1 of this act unless the personviolates the cease and desist or other order. This section does notapply to activities that are the subject of a cease and desist or otherorder issued under section 1 of this act and the person does notviolate such an order.
